reports.suggestion_message:
To solve this problem, you can try the following approaches:


- Some affected dependencies have newer versions available.
You may want to consider updating them to a newer version to see if the issue has been fixed.

getrandom v0.2.15 has the following newer versions available: 0.3.0-rc.0, 0.3.0, 0.3.1, 0.3.2
gloo-net v0.5.0 has the following newer versions available: 0.6.0

- If the issue is not solved by updating the dependencies, a fix has to be
implemented by those dependencies. You can help with that by notifying the
maintainers of this problem (e.g. by creating a bug report) or by proposing a
fix to the maintainers (e.g. by creating a pull request):

  - console_error_panic_hook@0.1.7
  - Repository: https://github.com/rustwasm/console_error_panic_hook
  - Detailed warning command: `cargo report future-incompatibilities --id 1 --package console_error_panic_hook@0.1.7`

  - getrandom@0.2.15
  - Repository: https://github.com/rust-random/getrandom
  - Detailed warning command: `cargo report future-incompatibilities --id 1 --package getrandom@0.2.15`

  - gloo-console@0.3.0

  - Detailed warning command: `cargo report future-incompatibilities --id 1 --package gloo-console@0.3.0`

  - gloo-history@0.2.2

  - gloo-net@0.5.0

  - gloo-timers@0.3.0
  - Repository: https://github.com/rustwasm/gloo/tree/master/crates/timers
  - Detailed warning command: `cargo report future-incompatibilities --id 1 --package gloo-timers@0.3.0`

  - js-sys@0.3.77
  - Repository: https://github.com/rustwasm/wasm-bindgen/tree/master/crates/js-sys

  - serde-wasm-bindgen@0.6.5
  - Repository: https://github.com/RReverser/serde-wasm-bindgen
  - Detailed warning command: `cargo report future-incompatibilities --id 1 --package serde-wasm-bindgen@0.6.5`

  - wasm-bindgen-futures@0.4.50
